name: 5% Niacinamide Body Wash - 700 ml
subtitle: Especially for winters

list.title: Full list of ingredients
list.content:
Patch tests are an easy way to make sure you don't experience any initial negative reaction when using a new product. We recommend doing a patch test prior to starting any new product on your skin. You can conduct a patch test by following the below steps:
1. Apply the product to a small patch of skin either to the arm or bend of the elbow
2. Keep the area dry
3. Leave on for 12-24 hours (or lesser if the product isn’t a leave-on product)
4. If any redness, itching or irritation is observed at any time during the test do not use the product, else you can safely use it

Ingredient Names
Aqua, Acrylate Copolymer, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Coco Glucoside, Sodium Lauroyl Sarcosinate, Niacinamide, Triethanolamine, Aloe Barbadensis (Aloe Vera) Leaf Extract, Erythritol, Perfume, Phenoxyethanol and Ethylhexylglycerin, Avena Sativa (Oat) Kernel Extract, Polysorbate-20, Blue Beads, Saccharide Isomerate (and) Citric Acid (and) Sodium Citrate, Disodium EDTA, Natural Vitamin E, CI 17200.
Formulated Without
Soap, Paraben, Mineral Oil, Fragrance, Sulphate, Silicone, Cruelty

list.title: Can I use niacinamide body wash every day?
list.content: Yes, we recommend using this body wash for all skin types once a day, every day.

list.title: Is niacinamide good for all skin types?
list.content: Yes - this body wash can be used by all skin types.

list.title: Can I use this twice a day?
list.content: We recommend consulting your expert to verify the same.

list.title: How much time will it take to see results?
list.content: We recommend checking with your expert as results will vary depending on the condition: however you should start noticing a change within 3 months

list.title: What does Niacinamide do for skin?
list.content: Niacinamide helps repair the protective layer of the skin. It promotes the production of ceramides and elastin. Over time it helps reduce melanin transfer to outer layer of skin, which helps fade marks.
